groups.imi_vm20i/dataset1: Spindle/workpiece and milling context recognizable in every reviewed sequence; coolant spray and window droplets partially obscure contact.
groups.imi_vm20i/dataset4: Spindle/workpiece context recognizable; strong window streaking and coolant obscure the tool edge throughout many cuts. Stable tool-defect class is not optically proven.
groups.imi_vm20i/dataset19: Milling motion/context recognizable; camera reflections and coolant obscure fine contact, particularly later cuts.
groups.imi_vmx30ui/dataset8: All 64 sequences retain recognizable spindle, rotary fixture/workpiece and milling context; coolant substantially obscures the exact contact region. Do not equate this with clear damage visibility.
groups.imi_vmx30ui/dataset9: Accepted sequences retain recognizable spindle/workpiece context. Coolant occlusion increases; no claim that the two abnormal cuts can be distinguished visually.
